newsitem.title: USA: HCC to raise sub's capital to over $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: HCC to raise sub's capital to over $50 mln.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc said Monday it will contribute capital to its newly-acquired subsidiary U.S. Specialty Insurance Co to raise the unit's total capital and surplus to more than $50 million.
HCC officials were not immediately available to say how much the capital injection would be.
The subsidiary will move its home office to Houston from St. Peters, Mo., and change its state of domicile to Texas, an HCC statement said.
USSIC is a property and casualty insurance company specializing in writing domestic general aviation insurance.

HCC's chief excecutive Stephen Way said in an interview U.S. Specialty had been part of AVEMCO Corp, bought by HCC for about $256 million on June 19. He added HCC's capital injection amounted to $40 million.
